description: KDPG aldolase trimer (3 chains, 605 residues) from the original ANMUtils example (kdpgt.dat, kdpg.par, kdpgt.par, kdpg.top).

AC.description: multi-chain protein-only ANM: AC (old) vs AC (new). On CUDA: DNANM with the protein-only topology (no CUDA AC) (not run with --same-code: on CUDA it is the same simulation as another case of this system)

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')

ANMT.description: multi-chain protein-only ANMT: ACT (old) vs DNACT with a protein-only topology (new)

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')

DNANM.description: multi-chain protein-only ANM through DNANM: DNANM (old) vs DNANM (new)

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')

ACT.description: protein-only ANMT: ACT (old) vs ACT (new). On CUDA: DNACT with the protein-only topology (no CUDA ACT) (not run with --same-code: on CUDA it is the same simulation as another case of this system)

*@CUDA_double.reason: the ANM interactions require use_edge = true on CUDA, and use_edge is not available in double precision (MD_CUDABackend: 'use_edge and double precision are not compatible')
